stem.text: The monomer buta-1,3-diene can undergo addition polymerisation in various ways. Two of the polymers that can be made are called *cis*-poly(buta-1,3-diene) and *trans*-poly(buta-1,3-diene). In these names *cis* and *trans* have their usual meanings.
What is the structure of the repeat unit of *cis*-poly(buta-1,3-diene)?

A.alt: Repeat unit in brackets with n: zigzag chain with two C=C double bonds.

B.alt: Repeat unit in brackets with n: zigzag chain with one C=C double bond.

C.alt: Repeat unit in brackets with n: one C=C double bond at the top of a U-shaped chain.

D.alt: Repeat unit in brackets with n: two C=C double bonds on the sloped bonds, single bond across the top.
